description: PAID ($0.009 USDC via x402). The newest satellite images of any coordinate, from the Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A archive (free, open imagery; ~10 m per pixel; a revisit every ~5 days) via Element 84's Earth Search catalogue: for each scene the capture time, cloud cover, MGRS tile, sun elevation, a small JPEG preview link and the full-resolution true-colour image as a Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF. Filter by a cloud limit (default 30%) and a look-back window (default 60 days, up to 365); newest first. No scene in the window answers 404 and is not charged. Every answer carries the attribution the Copernicus licence asks for. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

days.description: How far back to look, in days, 1-365 (default 60)

maxCloudPct.description: Only scenes with at most this much cloud, 0-100 (default 30)

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

asOf.description: ISO time the catalogue was read

attribution.description: The attribution the Copernicus licence asks for — keep it beside any use of the images

defaulted.description: Present only when the body was empty: which subject the answer is for, and why

filters.description: The cloud limit and look-back window applied

matched.description: Scenes the catalogue matched before the limit

note.description: How to use the image links, and their limits

gsdMeters.description: Ground distance per pixel of the true-colour image, in metres
